name: Xperia Acro

images.credit: R34SkylineGT-R V-SpecⅡNür, CC BY-SA 3.0 via Wikimedia Commons

Body.Form factor: Slate smartphone (Black, White, Aqua (SO-02C only) and Ruby (IS11S only))

Platform.CPU: Qualcomm MSM8255 1 GHz Scorpion (Snapdragon) Adreno 205 GPU (SO-02C), Qualcomm MSM8655 1 GHz Scorpion (Snapdragon) Adreno 205 GPU (IS11S)

Memory.Storage: Up to 32 GB on microSD memory card

Display.Display: 4.2 inch 854×480 px FWVGA "Reality Display" TFT LCD at 233 PPI with Mobile BRAVIA Engine, 16M Colors

Cameras.Rear camera: 8.1 MP (3264×2448), Back-illuminated sensor Exmor R CMOS Sensor, Auto Focus, Face recognition, Geo-tagging, Image and video stabilizer, Smile detection, Touch focus, Video 720p HD (Android 2.3)

Connectivity.Connectivity: Bluetooth 2.1 with A2DP, microUSB 2.0, 3.5 mm audio jack, aGPS, Wi-Fi 802.11 b/g/n, HDMI
